Connect your app to OBS.

Keep the Windows app running. Your overlay connects directly on this PC, works without an account, and updates as your tracker changes.

OBS connection off
  1. Enable the overlay, then copy its link.
  2. In OBS, add a Browser Source and paste the link into URL. Leave Local file off.
  3. Start with Width 420 and Height 900. Drag and scale it in your scene. Increase the height for more rows or larger text.

The OBS canvas stays transparent around the list. This link works on this PC only. No OBS plug-in, cloud account, or extra download is needed.

Put the live list on stream.

The Windows app provides a direct local connection to OBS. Install it, open this tab there, and choose Enable OBS overlay. Sign in to bring your website progress across, or import a backup.

View all feedback ↗

Continues on GitHub. A free GitHub account is needed to post or reply. Everyone can browse the feedback.

Posts and attachments are public. Keep passwords, account details, and save backups out of reports. The tracker only fills in its version, app type, and catalogue date; it does not attach your progress.

You can review your report before submitting it. The maintainer can reply on the same page, and you can return there to follow the conversation.
